summary.text: RYGGE MØLLE OG HANDELSFORRETNING AS is a private limited company registered in Rygge, founded 1879-01-01. RYGGE MØLLE OG HANDELSFORRETNING AS registrerer seg for å utvikle og investere i fast eiendom og drive utleie, samt forretningsvirksomhet som naturlig hører inn under dette. Formålet omfatter også å eie og drive fast eiendom, kjøpe og selge fast eiendom og delta i andre selskaper. It was previously named AS Rygge Handelsforretning until 2002-07-06. Its main industry code is 68.200: rental and operating of own or leased real estate. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 2 506 197 NOK and the annual result was -85 773 NOK; operating income was down from 2 740 129 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from -325 995 NOK in 2024 to -85 773 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 11 650 911 NOK in 2024 to 11 565 138 NOK in 2025. The register's most recent update was on 2026-04-27 (sisteInnsendteAarsregnskap).
